information:

​This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2024. **The registration process will reserve 20 spots for new competitors.** New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. Carefully read the instructions on the [WCA Newcomer Month tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GeelBeginnersSunday2024#40091-wca-newcomer-month).

Your registration is only complete after paying the registration fee via the WCA website. Registrations will be accepted based on the moment of payment. Carefully read the[ registration instructions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GeelBeginnersSunday2024#40091-registration).
​

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZzhYIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--63de4aa9b1fe90f9c4af2cc3b2e86ed03f17ffda/warning.png)  
This competition is a twin competition with [Geel Beginners Saturday 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GeelBeginnersSaturday2024). **You can only register for one of day!**
